summary: Auto-growing text area with a pixel character budget that turns amber near the limit and blinks red when over, marking the form invalid.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial text when uncontrolled. A form reset restores it.

props.name: limit
props.description: Character budget. Typing past it is allowed but marks the field invalid.

props.name: label
props.description: Label above the field, linked to the textarea.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name; the text submits under it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the textarea and dims the field.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the textarea as required for form validation.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called on every edit with the new text.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: Called when the textarea commits a change: on blur after editing (the native `change` event).

accessibility: A native `<textarea>` labelled by a `<label htmlFor>`.

The counter ("40 left", or "−5" when over) describes the textarea (`aria-describedby`) in words, for example "40 of 120 characters left". It is not a live region: a visually hidden `role="status"` announces the budget only when the text reaches 80% of the limit or goes over it.
Over the limit the textarea has `aria-invalid` and a custom validity message.
motion: With reduced motion the budget bar jumps to the new length and the over-limit pixels do not blink.
form: A native `<textarea>` submits the text under `name`. Over `limit` it sets the custom validity message "Keep it to N characters or fewer", which blocks submission and anchors the browser's validation bubble to the field. Form reset restores `defaultValue` and calls `onValueChange` when that changes the text.
notes: The textarea grows with its content from a minimum height of 84 px, refits when its width changes, and has no resize handle.
The root carries `data-zone` set to `ok`, `warn` (from 80% of the limit) or `over`.
`className` and other `div` props go to the wrapper; textarea attributes are the props listed above.

props.label: Short bio
props.placeholder: A sentence or two about you
